title: JIN: Kakutoha Oden

synopsis: In the not-too-distant future... In a society where corruption has spread and dreams and hopes have disappeared, an illegal, no-rules underground fighting sport called "Yaoyorozu" has thrived. Brutal street fights are waged anywhere and everywhere, driven by money and human desire. Jin Matsuya, a delinquent who repeatedly steals from the city, gets caught up in the violence.
